name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.CertDual.dichotomy
title: Certificate-dual dichotomy: perfect hiding when the target is in the span, otherwise a decrypting functional exists
statement: Let K be a field, U a finite K-module, V a K-module, L : U -> V linear and t in V. (1) If t is in the range of L then for every f : V -> R, every e in V and every beta in K, sum_u f(L u + e + beta t) = sum_u f(L u + e): the law of L u + e + beta t for uniform u does not depend on beta. (2) If t is not in the range of L then there is a linear functional h on V with h o L = 0 and h t = 1. (3) Every functional h with h o L = 0 satisfies h(L u + e + beta t) = h e + beta * h t. Used in note pq-we-new-directions for noisy-linear encodings whose security comes from an algebraic unsatisfiability certificate.
